description: Defines the MappingOutcome interface and related classes for handling message mapping results (mapped, dropped, error) in a messaging system, including visitor pattern and builder for evaluation.

classes.name: MappingOutcome
classes.description: Interface representing the outcome of message mapping, with static factory methods for creating different outcomes and nested interfaces/classes for visitor pattern and builder.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.Visitor
classes.description: Visitor interface for processing different mapping outcomes.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.VisitorBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing a visitor with custom evaluation functions.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.OnError
classes.description: Functional interface for handling error outcomes.

methods.name: MappingOutcome.mapped
methods.description: Creates a mapped outcome with specified mapper ID, message, topic, and external message.

methods.name: MappingOutcome.dropped
methods.description: Creates a dropped message outcome with specified mapper ID and external message.

methods.name: MappingOutcome.error
methods.description: Creates an error outcome with specified mapper ID, exception, topic, and external message.

methods.name: MappingOutcome.newVisitorBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for creating a visitor to evaluate outcomes.

search-terms: Outcome of inbound and outbound message mapping
Java interface for message mapping results
